reply_text:
The store is **Pine Crossing**, and I've replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message.

- **Where it comes from:** Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 June 2026. She wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support try it with the store login.
- **What's missing:** I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in what Pree can see: #central-team, #central-random or the public Central team files. I told her that, in case the sheet needs more than the store name.
- **gbrain didn't work:** the search was refused and returned nothing, because its access token isn't tied to any member. Whoever runs the brain server can fix this with `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`, or by setting it up as a shared agent with `--may-act-for`. That's a decision for the admin, so I didn't try to change it. I answered from the channels and files Pree can see.
